items.title: Craft over shortcuts
items.description: Every joint, finish, and structural decision is made for durability first, appearance second — the two usually agree.

items.title: Clarity before build
items.description: We scope, measure, and confirm before a single cut is made, so there are no surprises mid-project.

items.title: Built for real use
items.description: Furniture gets sat on, arches get leaned against, basements get lived in — we build for that reality.
